title: Out and about
blurb: Shopping, buses and rickshaws, directions, weather, the doctor and school, in the past and future tenses.

sentences.en: I went to the market yesterday. (a man speaking)
sentences.note: કાલે means yesterday here because the verb is in the past.

sentences.en: I bought vegetables from the market.
sentences.note: With મેં, the past verb agrees with the thing bought. શાક is neuter, so ખરીદ્યું.

sentences.en: I bought a kilo of tomatoes.
sentences.note: ટામેટાં is neuter plural, so the verb ends in -ાં. લેવું (to take) is the everyday word for buying.

sentences.en: How much is this sari?
sentences.note: કેટલાનો / કેટલાની / કેટલાનું matches the item. સાડી is feminine.

sentences.gu: બહુ મોંઘું છે, થોડું ઓછું કરો.
sentences.tr: bahu monghun chhe, thoDun ochhun karo.
sentences.en: It's too expensive, please bring the price down a little.
Bananas are forty rupees a dozen.
sentences.note: રૂપિયે ડઝન = rupees per dozen.

sentences.gu: મારે એક કિલો ખાંડ જોઈએ છે.
sentences.tr: maare ek kilo khaanD joiye chhe.
sentences.en: I need a kilo of sugar.
sentences.note: મારે (or મને) ... જોઈએ છે = I need / I want ...

sentences.gu: દુકાનદારે મને દસ રૂપિયા પાછા આપ્યા.
sentences.tr: dukaandaare mane das roopiyaa paachhaa aapyaa.
sentences.en: The shopkeeper gave me ten rupees back.
sentences.note: આપ્યા agrees with રૂપિયા (masculine plural).

sentences.gu: આ દુકાનમાં બધું સસ્તું મળે છે.
sentences.tr: aa dukaanmaan badhun sastun maLe chhe.
sentences.en: Everything is cheap in this shop.
sentences.note: મળવું here means to be available: lit. "everything is found cheap".

sentences.en: The vegetable seller has fresh tomatoes.
sentences.note: X પાસે ... છે = X has ... (lit. "... is near X").

sentences.en: I bought a sari for Mom.
I don't like this colour.
sentences.note: In the negative, ગમતો / ગમતી agrees with the thing liked. રંગ is masculine.

sentences.en: Do you have a small bag?
sentences.note: થેલી is feminine, so નાની.

sentences.gu: દુકાન સવારે નવ વાગ્યે ખૂલે છે.
sentences.tr: dukaan savaare nav vaagye khoole chhe.
sentences.en: The shop opens at nine in the morning.
sentences.note: નવ વાગ્યે = at nine o'clock.

sentences.en: The market is closed on Tuesdays.
sentences.note: હોય છે is used for things that are usually true.

sentences.en: What time will the bus come?
The train is ten minutes late.
sentences.note: ટ્રેન is feminine, so મોડી.

sentences.gu: મેં સ્ટેશન પર બે ટિકિટ લીધી.
sentences.tr: men sTeshan par be TikiT leedhee.
sentences.en: I bought two tickets at the station.
sentences.note: ટિકિટ is feminine, so મેં ... લીધી.

sentences.en: (To a rickshaw driver) I need to go to the station, please.
sentences.note: મારે + -વું છે = I want to / I need to. ભાઈ is a polite way to address a man you don't know.

sentences.en: How much will it be to the station?

sentences.gu: જરા ધીમે ચલાવો, મને ડર લાગે છે.
sentences.tr: jaraa dheeme chalaavo, mane Dar laage chhe.
sentences.en: Please drive slower, I'm scared.
(To a rickshaw driver) Stop right here, please.
sentences.note: ઊભી agrees with રિક્ષા, which is feminine.

sentences.en: We went to Ahmedabad by train.
Next week I will go to Mumbai.

sentences.gu: ગયા અઠવાડિયે અમે ગામ ગયા હતા.
sentences.tr: gayaa aThvaaDiye ame gaam gayaa hataa.
sentences.en: Last week we went to our village.

sentences.gu: બસ સ્ટેન્ડ અહીંથી કેટલું દૂર છે?
sentences.tr: bas sTenD aheenthee keTlun door chhe?
sentences.en: How far is the bus stand from here?
I missed my bus.
sentences.note: બસ છૂટી જવી = to miss the bus (lit. the bus got away). બસ is feminine.

sentences.en: Where did you get the ticket from?
The train will leave at six in the morning.
sentences.note: ઊપડવું = to set off (trains, buses).

sentences.en: We came home by rickshaw.

sentences.gu: સીધા જાઓ અને પછી ડાબી બાજુ વળો.
sentences.tr: seedhaa jaao ane pachhee Daabee baaju vaLo.
sentences.en: Go straight and then turn left.
sentences.note: બાજુ (side) is feminine: ડાબી બાજુ = left, જમણી બાજુ = right.

sentences.en: The clinic is near the market.
The bank is opposite the temple.

sentences.gu: અહીંથી બીજી ગલીમાં જમણી બાજુ વળજો.
sentences.tr: aheenthee beejee galeemaan jamNee baaju vaLjo.
sentences.en: Turn right at the second lane from here.
sentences.note: ગલી is feminine, so બીજી. The -જો ending (વળજો) makes a softer, polite instruction.

sentences.en: Which way is the station?
sentences.note: કયો / કઈ / કયું = which, agreeing with the noun. બાજુ is feminine.

sentences.en: The temple is near here.
Will you show me the way?

sentences.gu: ઘરથી શાળા દસ મિનિટ દૂર છે.
sentences.tr: gharthee shaaLaa das miniT door chhe.
sentences.en: School is ten minutes from home.
It was very hot this afternoon.
sentences.note: ગરમી = heat, ઠંડી = cold (both nouns).

sentences.en: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.note: વરસાદ પડવો = to rain (lit. rain falls).

sentences.gu: ગઈ કાલે રાત્રે ખૂબ વરસાદ પડ્યો.
sentences.tr: gai kaale raatre khoob varsaad paDyo.
sentences.en: It rained a lot last night.
sentences.note: વરસાદ is masculine, so પડ્યો. ગઈ કાલે = yesterday.

sentences.gu: શિયાળામાં અહીં બહુ ઠંડી પડે છે.
sentences.tr: shiyaaLaamaan aheen bahu ThanDee paDe chhe.
sentences.en: It gets very cold here in winter.
sentences.note: Seasons: ઉનાળો (summer), ચોમાસું (monsoon), શિયાળો (winter).

sentences.gu: ઉનાળામાં અમે રોજ કેરી ખાઈએ છીએ.
sentences.tr: unaaLaamaan ame roj keree khaaiye chhiye.
sentences.en: In summer we eat mangoes every day.

sentences.gu: ચોમાસામાં રસ્તા પર પાણી ભરાય છે.
sentences.tr: chomaasaamaan rastaa par paaNee bharaay chhe.
sentences.en: In the monsoon, water collects on the roads.
There are clouds in the sky today.
It's cold, wear a sweater.
What time is it now?
sentences.note: કેટલા વાગ્યા છે? = what time is it? but કેટલા વાગ્યે? = at what time?

sentences.gu: હું સાડા સાત વાગ્યે ઘરેથી નીકળું છું.
sentences.tr: hun saaDaa saat vaagye gharethee neekaLun chhun.
sentences.en: I leave home at half past seven.
sentences.note: સવા = quarter past, સાડા = half past, પોણા = quarter to.

sentences.en: I have a day off tomorrow.

sentences.gu: હું રોજ સવારે છ વાગ્યે ઊઠું છું.
sentences.tr: hun roj savaare chha vaagye ooThun chhun.
sentences.en: I get up at six every morning.
We will go to see a film on Saturday.
sentences.note: જોવા જવું = to go to see.

sentences.gu: એક વર્ષમાં બાર મહિના હોય છે.
sentences.tr: ek varshmaan baar mahinaa hoy chhe.
sentences.en: There are twelve months in a year.
Yesterday was Friday.
sentences.note: વાર (day of the week) is masculine, so હતો.

sentences.en: The day after tomorrow is my birthday.
sentences.note: જન્મદિવસ is masculine, so મારો.

sentences.en: I have had a fever for two days.
sentences.note: થી with a length of time means for / since.

sentences.en: My head has been hurting since yesterday.
The doctor gave me medicine.
sentences.note: With a past transitive verb the doer takes -એ (ડૉક્ટરે), and the verb agrees with દવા (feminine).

sentences.gu: આ દવા દિવસમાં બે વાર લો.
sentences.tr: aa davaa divasmaan be vaar lo.
sentences.en: Take this medicine twice a day.
sentences.note: લો is the polite command of લેવું (to take).

sentences.en: When will the doctor come?
sentences.note: સાહેબ is a respectful title, like "sir".

sentences.en: I have a cold and a cough.
sentences.note: મને ... છે = I have (an illness): મને તાવ છે, મને શરદી છે.

sentences.gu: તમારે થોડા દિવસ આરામ કરવો પડશે.
sentences.tr: tamaare thoDaa divas aaraam karvo paDshe.
sentences.en: You will have to rest for a few days.
sentences.note: તમારે ... -વો પડશે = you will have to ...

sentences.en: I have a stomach ache.

sentences.gu: દવાખાનું સાંજે પાંચ વાગ્યે બંધ થાય છે.
sentences.tr: davaakhaanun saanje paanch vaagye bandh thaay chhe.
sentences.en: The clinic closes at five in the evening.

sentences.gu: ગરમ પાણી પીઓ અને આરામ કરો.
sentences.tr: garam paaNee peeo ane aaraam karo.
sentences.en: Drink warm water and rest.

sentences.gu: હું રોજ ચાલીને શાળાએ જાઉં છું.
sentences.tr: hun roj chaaleene shaaLaae jaaun chhun.
sentences.en: I walk to school every day.
sentences.note: -એ can mean "to" a place: શાળાએ, ઘરે.

sentences.en: The teacher told us a story.
sentences.note: વાર્તા is feminine, so શિક્ષકે ... કહી.

sentences.en: My maths exam was yesterday.
sentences.note: નો / ની / નું agrees with what follows: પરીક્ષા is feminine.

sentences.gu: મારી બહેન દસમા ધોરણમાં ભણે છે.
sentences.tr: maaree bahen dasmaa dhoraNmaan bhaNe chhe.
sentences.en: My sister is in the tenth grade.
sentences.note: ભણવું = to study (at school).

sentences.gu: મારા પપ્પા બેંકમાં કામ કરે છે.
sentences.tr: maaraa pappaa benkmaan kaam kare chhe.
sentences.en: My dad works in a bank.
Dad will come back from work in the evening.
sentences.note: પરથી = from: કામ પરથી = from work.

sentences.en: I have a lot of work today.
sentences.note: કામ is neuter, so ઘણું.

sentences.en: I will come early tomorrow morning. (a man speaking)
sentences.note: વહેલો is for a male speaker; a woman would say વહેલી.

sentences.en: Please sit here.
sentences.note: જરા softens a request, a bit like "just" or "please".

sentences.en: Please give me a glass of water.

sentences.gu: જરા રાહ જુઓ, હું આવું છું.
sentences.tr: jaraa raah juo, hun aavun chhun.
sentences.en: Wait a moment, I'm coming.
sentences.note: રાહ જોવી = to wait.

sentences.en: Please close the door.

sentences.gu: જરા ફરીથી બોલો, મને સમજાયું નહીં.
sentences.tr: jaraa phareethee bolo, mane samjaayun naheen.
sentences.en: Please say that again, I didn't understand.
Open the window, it's very hot.
Please write your name here.
Could you help me a little?
sentences.note: મદદ is feminine, so થોડી.

sentences.en: Come on, let's go out for a walk.
sentences.note: આપણે = we, including the person you're talking to.

sentences.gu: મારે અમદાવાદની એક ટિકિટ જોઈએ છે.
sentences.tr: maare amdaavaadnee ek TikiT joiye chhe.
sentences.en: I need one ticket to Ahmedabad.
I want to see the doctor.
sentences.note: મળવું (to meet) takes ને: ડૉક્ટરને મળવું.

sentences.en: What would you like?
I want to go home.
sentences.note: મારે + -વું છે = I want to / I need to.

sentences.en: We want to buy a new house.
sentences.note: ઘર is neuter, so નવું.

sentences.gu: ચાલો જમીએ, મને ભૂખ લાગી છે.
sentences.tr: chaalo jamiye, mane bhookh laagee chhe.
sentences.en: Let's eat, I'm hungry.
sentences.note: મને ભૂખ લાગી છે = I'm hungry (lit. hunger has struck me).

sentences.gu: મને તરસ લાગી છે, પાણી આપો.
sentences.tr: mane taras laagee chhe, paaNee aapo.
sentences.en: I'm thirsty, please give me some water.
sentences.note: તરસ is feminine, so લાગી.

sentences.en: Give me two kilos of potatoes.
I really like the rain.
sentences.note: મને X ગમે છે = I like X (lit. X pleases me).

sentences.gu: મારા ભાઈને ક્રિકેટ રમવું ગમે છે.
sentences.tr: maaraa bhaaine krikeT ramvun game chhe.
sentences.en: My brother likes playing cricket.
I don't like crowds at all.
sentences.note: ભીડ is feminine, so નથી ગમતી.

sentences.en: Which season do you like?

sentences.gu: મને ઉનાળો નથી ગમતો, બહુ ગરમી હોય છે.
sentences.tr: mane unaaLo nathee gamto, bahu garmee hoy chhe.
sentences.en: I don't like summer, it gets very hot.

sentences.gu: મારી દાદીને મંદિર જવું ગમે છે.
sentences.tr: maaree daadeene mandir javun game chhe.
sentences.en: My grandmother likes going to the temple.

sentences.gu: મને ગુજરાતી ખાવાનું બહુ ભાવે છે.
sentences.tr: mane gujaraatee khaavaanun bahu bhaave chhe.
sentences.en: I really love Gujarati food.
sentences.note: ભાવવું is "to like" for food.

sentences.en: (To a friend) Do you like mangoes?
The key is on the table.

sentences.gu: હું મારા મિત્ર સાથે ફિલ્મ જોવા ગયો.
sentences.tr: hun maaraa mitra saathe philm jovaa gayo.
sentences.en: I went to see a film with my friend. (a man speaking)
This letter is for you.
My friend's sister is a doctor.
sentences.note: બહેન is feminine, so મિત્રની.

sentences.en: Whose umbrella is this?
sentences.note: છત્રી is feminine, so કોની.

sentences.en: Whose phone is this?
sentences.note: ફોન is masculine, so કોનો.

sentences.gu: મારા ઘરની પાછળ એક બગીચો છે.
sentences.tr: maaraa gharnee paachhaL ek bageecho chhe.
sentences.en: There is a garden behind my house.
I phoned him (or her).
sentences.note: ફોન is masculine, so મેં ફોન કર્યો.

sentences.gu: મારા મિત્રે મને એક પુસ્તક આપ્યું.
sentences.tr: maaraa mitre mane ek pustak aapyun.
sentences.en: My friend gave me a book.
sentences.note: પુસ્તક is neuter, so આપ્યું.

sentences.gu: હું સાંજે મારી માસીને ત્યાં જઈશ.
sentences.tr: hun saanje maaree maaseene tyaan jaish.
sentences.en: This evening I will go to my aunt's place.
sentences.note: X ને ત્યાં = at / to X's home.

sentences.gu: શું તમે ગઈ કાલે બજાર ગયા હતા?
sentences.tr: shun tame gai kaale bajaar gayaa hataa?
sentences.en: Did you go to the market yesterday?
When will you come back?
They will come from the village tomorrow morning.
The girls are playing in the garden.

sentences.gu: મારો મિત્ર ગઈ કાલે લંડનથી આવ્યો.
sentences.tr: maaro mitra gai kaale lanDanthee aavyo.
sentences.en: My friend came from London yesterday.
My sister will go to America tomorrow.
In the evening we went for a walk on the beach.
sentences.note: ફરવા જવું = to go out for a walk or trip.

sentences.en: Mom made khichdi today.
sentences.note: ખીચડી is feminine, so મમ્મીએ ... બનાવી.

sentences.en: Dad read the newspaper in the morning.
sentences.note: With a past transitive verb the doer takes -એ: પપ્પાએ.

sentences.gu: મેં સવારે બે કપ ચા પીધી.
sentences.tr: men savaare be kap chaa peedhee.
sentences.en: I drank two cups of tea in the morning.
sentences.note: ચા is feminine, so મેં ચા પીધી.

sentences.en: Have you had lunch?
sentences.note: Lit. "did you eat in the afternoon or not?" જમવું = to have a meal.

sentences.gu: ગઈ કાલે અમે નવી ગાડી ખરીદી.
sentences.tr: gai kaale ame navee gaaDee khareedee.
sentences.en: Yesterday we bought a new car.
sentences.note: ગાડી is feminine, so નવી.

sentences.en: The boy fell off his bicycle.

sentences.gu: ગામમાં મારા દાદાનું મોટું ઘર છે.
sentences.tr: gaammaan maaraa daadaanun moTun ghar chhe.
sentences.en: My grandfather has a big house in the village.
sentences.note: ઘર is neuter, so દાદાનું.

sentences.gu: ભાઈ, આ બસ ગાંધીનગર જાય છે?
sentences.tr: bhaai, aa bas gaandheenagar jaay chhe?
sentences.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to Gandhinagar?

sentences.gu: પહેલાં હાથ ધોઈ લો, પછી જમો.
sentences.tr: pahelaan haath dhoi lo, pachhee jamo.
sentences.en: First wash your hands, then eat.
We will go to our village for Diwali.
The market was very crowded.
sentences.note: ભીડ (crowd) is feminine, so હતી.

sentences.gu: શું આ રસ્તો સ્ટેશન તરફ જાય છે?
sentences.tr: shun aa rasto sTeshan taraph jaay chhe?
sentences.en: Does this road go towards the station?
Will you take sugar in your tea?

sentences.gu: હું દર રવિવારે મંદિરે જાઉં છું.
sentences.tr: hun dar ravivaare mandire jaaun chhun.
sentences.en: I go to the temple every Sunday.
Which village are you from?
sentences.note: With તમે the ending is plural: ગામના.

sentences.gu: આ ઘર સો વર્ષ જૂનું છે.
sentences.tr: aa ghar so varsh joonun chhe.
sentences.en: This house is a hundred years old.

sentences.gu: ટ્રેનમાં બારી પાસે બેસવું મને ગમે છે.
sentences.tr: Trenmaan baaree paase besvun mane game chhe.
sentences.en: I like sitting by the window on the train.
The rickshaw fare came to a hundred rupees.
sentences.note: ભાડું (fare) is neuter, so રિક્ષાનું.

sentences.en: I will meet you at the station.
Where shall we meet tomorrow?
I don't have any change.
sentences.note: છૂટા પૈસા = small change.

sentences.en: This mango is sweet.

sentences.gu: ગઈ કાલે મેં નવાં કપડાં ખરીદ્યાં.
sentences.tr: gai kaale men navaan kapDaan khareedyaan.
sentences.en: Yesterday I bought new clothes.
sentences.note: કપડાં is neuter plural, so નવાં and ખરીદ્યાં.

sentences.en: Show me another colour.
sentences.note: રંગ is masculine, so બીજો.

sentences.gu: અહીં સારી ચા ક્યાં મળે છે?
sentences.tr: aheen saaree chaa kyaan maLe chhe?
sentences.en: Where can you get good tea around here?

sentences.gu: હું દસ મિનિટમાં પાછો આવું છું.
sentences.tr: hun das miniTmaan paachho aavun chhun.
sentences.en: I'll be back in ten minutes. (a man speaking)

sentences.gu: મને ગુજરાતી થોડું થોડું આવડે છે.
sentences.tr: mane gujaraatee thoDun thoDun aavDe chhe.
sentences.en: I know a little Gujarati.
sentences.note: આવડવું = to know how (a language, a skill); the person takes ને: મને આવડે છે.

sentences.gu: અમારી શાળા આઠ વાગ્યે શરૂ થાય છે.
sentences.tr: amaaree shaaLaa aaTh vaagye sharoo thaay chhe.
sentences.en: Our school starts at eight o'clock.
sentences.note: શાળા is feminine, so અમારી.

sentences.gu: શિક્ષક વર્ગમાં બોર્ડ પર લખે છે.
sentences.tr: shikshak vargmaan borD par lakhe chhe.
sentences.en: The teacher writes on the board in class.
I finished my work.
sentences.note: પૂરું કરવું = to finish.

sentences.en: When will your work be finished?
He (or she) got a job.
sentences.note: With મળવું (to get), the person takes ને and the verb agrees with the thing you get: નોકરી is feminine, so મળી.

sentences.gu: હું દર અઠવાડિયે દાદીને ફોન કરું છું.
sentences.tr: hun dar aThvaaDiye daadeene phon karun chhun.
sentences.en: I phone Grandma every week.

sentences.gu: એક કપ ચા અને બે સમોસા આપો.
sentences.tr: ek kap chaa ane be samosaa aapo.
sentences.en: One cup of tea and two samosas, please.

sentences.gu: મારી પાસે સો રૂપિયા જ છે.
sentences.tr: maaree paase so roopiyaa j chhe.
sentences.en: I only have a hundred rupees.
sentences.note: જ = only, just. It comes right after the word it limits.

sentences.gu: ગાડી ધીમે ચલાવજો, રસ્તો ખરાબ છે.
sentences.tr: gaaDee dheeme chalaavjo, rasto kharaab chhe.
sentences.en: Drive slowly, the road is bad.
I liked this city a lot.
sentences.note: શહેર is neuter, so ગમ્યું.

sentences.en: Where can I get a bottle of water?
sentences.note: બોટલ is feminine, so પાણીની.

sentences.en: Please wake me up when the train comes.
sentences.note: ... ત્યારે = when ... (not a question). ક્યારે? asks "when?"

sentences.en: Tonight we will eat out.
Please stand in the queue.

sentences.gu: ચાલો જલદી કરો, મોડું થાય છે.
sentences.tr: chaalo jaldee karo, moDun thaay chhe.
sentences.en: Come on, hurry up, it's getting late.
sentences.note: મોડું થવું = to get late.

sentences.en: Where are you living these days?

sentences.gu: હું મારા કાકા સાથે શહેરમાં રહું છું.
sentences.tr: hun maaraa kaakaa saathe shahermaan rahun chhun.
sentences.en: I live in the city with my uncle.
How many days will you stay?

sentences.gu: અમે બે દિવસ પછી પાછા આવીશું.
sentences.tr: ame be divas pachhee paachhaa aaveeshun.
sentences.en: We will come back in two days.
In the summer holidays we will go travelling.
sentences.note: રજાઓ (holidays) is feminine plural, so ઉનાળાની.

sentences.en: Take an umbrella with you in the rain.
sentences.note: Lit. "go taking an umbrella in the rain". જજો is a polite "(do) go".

sentences.en: I left my phone at home.
sentences.note: Lit. "my phone stayed at home". ફોન is masculine, so મારો.

sentences.en: I took the wrong bus by mistake.
sentences.note: બસ is feminine, so ખોટી and પકડી.

sentences.en: There was a lot of traffic on the way.
I'll get there in five minutes.
We reached the station on time.
